cleanupProviderWeights: 恢复 DNS 默认权重
cleanupCaCertificate: 重置 HTTPS 抓包证书
blockResponseNxdomainDescription: 返回域名不存在，并提供 5 分钟负缓存以减少重复查询
Answers that the domain does not exist, with a 5-minute negative cache to reduce repeated queries
blockResponseNodataDescription: 返回域名存在但没有该记录，并提供 5 分钟负缓存
Answers that the domain exists but has no such record, with a 5-minute negative cache
blockResponseRefusedDescription: 返回服务器拒绝该查询，不提供缓存记录
Answers that the server refused the query, with no cached record
blockResponseZeroAddressDescription: A 返回 0.0.0.0，AAAA 返回 ::，其他类型返回空结果
A answers 0.0.0.0, AAAA answers ::, other types get an empty answer
cachePresetConservativeDescription: 遵从 DNS 服务器返回的有效期，不主动延长缓存时间，适合经常切换网络或对实时性敏感的场景。
Uses the TTL the DNS server returns and never extends it. Best for people who switch networks often or need real-time answers.
cachePresetStandardSummary: 最长 1 小时，短记录至少 1 分钟
At most 1 hour, short records at least 1 minute
cachePresetStandardDescription: 减少重复查询，同时避免记录过期滞后。解析失败时可短暂使用 5 分钟内的旧记录应急。
Cuts repeated queries without letting records lag behind. When resolution fails, records up to 5 minutes old may be reused as a stopgap.
cachePresetAggressiveSummary: 最长 6 小时，短记录至少 2 分钟
At most 6 hours, short records at least 2 minutes
cachePresetAggressiveDescription: 更偏向降低网络请求次数和提升弱网可用性。域名变更时更新可能会稍慢一些。
Favours fewer network requests and better usability on weak networks. Domain changes may take longer to show up.
cacheDisabledSummary: 已关闭 · 每次解析都会请求上游
upstreamDohNeedsHttps: DoH 地址必须以 https:// 开头
A DoH address must start with https://
upstreamDohInvalidUrl: DoH 地址不是合法的 URL
The DoH address is not a valid URL
upstreamPortRange: The port must be between 1 and 65535
upstreamIpv6Invalid: The IPv6 address is not valid
